title: Card
description: A power, fear, event or blight card. data/cards.json is an array of these. Images come from SICK, at https://sick.oberien.de/imgs/<powers|fears|events|blights>/<sickSlug>.webp, unless the card sets `image`. A unique power's spirit is recorded on that spirit's `uniques`, not here.

sickSlug.description: The card's lookup slug. For cards SICK has, also its image filename there; cards SICK doesn't have (e.g. Apocrypha uniques) use the same style and set `image`.

image.description: Image url for a card SICK doesn't have. When set, it is used instead of the SICK image.

elements.description: Power cards: elements the card provides.

range.description: Power cards: range as printed, e.g. '2' or ':SacredSite: 1'. Absent when the card has none (it targets a spirit).

targetType.description: Power cards: whether it targets a land or a spirit.

target.description: Power cards: target as printed, e.g. 'Any', 'Invaders', 'Another'.

text.description: Power cards: rules text, one entry per paragraph. Icons are written as :Name: tokens (e.g. :InvaderTown:, :TokenFear:), as in adversary rules; a lone 'or' separates alternatives.

levels.description: Fear card effects for terror levels I, II and III.

aliases.description: Other names the card is searched by, e.g. the titles of an event card's sub-events.

stillHealthy.description: Blight cards: true for a 'Still-Healthy Island' card, false for 'Blighted Island'.
